selection: Preregistered before any round-005 inference. Hypotheses come from the exploratory paired tests on rounds 001-004; round-005 uses new cases and fresh samples.
decision: Primary 1 (effort): the pooled one-sided paired permutation p for plain max minus medium no-evidence pass@10, averaged over Opus 5.5, GPT-6.1 Terra and GPT-6 Astra, is at most 0.05.

Primary 2 (meta prompt): the pooled two-sided paired permutation p for meta minus plain no-evidence pass@10 over all six model-effort pairs is at most 0.05; the sign of the pooled estimate gives the direction.
Each primary family has its own 5% error rate. Per-model results are secondary and use Holm-adjusted p within their family.
Every planned job counts; invalid answers are misses. If the round stops early, the confirmatory tests are not reported.
Conservative fixed-prompt bounds and scenario sensitivity are reported alongside, as for earlier rounds.
